status: Pass for the tested fixed candidate

candidate.deployment: Two updated daemon payloads installed for the physical run; exact identities below. GUI recovery changes tested from source and extracted packages.
candidate.hardware_controller: Real system D-Bus service, normal desktop user, actual Polkit

fixes.issue: Legacy startup acknowledged a shell before an operational AP; later starts failed.
fixes.diagnosis: A forking stdbuf wrapper left hostapd alive after cleanup. Its nl80211 registrations caused Register spurious class3 failed: EBUSY on subsequent starts.
changes: Launch hostapd directly and track its actual PID.
Acknowledge readiness only after hostapd reports ENABLED; require the matching PID acknowledgement and a runtime channel in daemon status.
Clean up owned workers after failed startup even when not active; wait for their exit on Stop.
Reject a NetworkManager release timeout, restore virtual AP mode after release, and avoid P2P MAC addresses without netdevs.

fixes.issue: HTTP timeout and intermittent restart/rejoin traffic failures in the old validation.
changes: Read HTTP Content-Length and chunked framing instead of waiting for socket EOF; fail truncated responses.
Bind DNS and TCP probes to the connected Android Wi-Fi Network.
Require the current AP BSSID, refetch DHCP addresses after association, and wait for Android network registration before traffic assertions.
Verify only owned interfaces and profiles during cleanup; unrelated Docker interface changes are not Relay leaks.
fixes.attribution_limit: Old transient TCP failures lacked enough evidence for an individual root cause. No NetworkManager routing fix is claimed. The corrected fixture passed all ten repeated two-client DNS/HTTPS rejoin checks.

verification.positive_https_and_invalid_certificate_c: Pass on both clients and both backends

fixes.issue: Headless GNOME extension disable reached the real system bus and stopped the live hotspot during a concurrent transfer.
changes: Map the headless Shell system bus to its private session bus.
Add a wrapper regression verifying both Shell and its probe receive that private bus.
fixes.verification: Real GNOME load/disable/enable passed concurrently with two-client NetworkManager transfers; the same AP remained active.

automatic_validation.note: The automatic runner does not itself run physical traffic. This document records the separate authorized physical run.

hardware.dns: Unique gateway queries compared with the same question sent directly through the Wi-Fi upstream resolver; NXDOMAIN and matching upstream NOERROR are distinguished.

traffic.protocol: 8 MiB upload and 8 MiB download per client session, authenticated local endpoint, SHA-256 in both directions, concurrent clients

cases.name: NM Wi-Fi-only concurrent transfer after smoke isolation fix

smoke_concurrency.name: GNOME smoke does not stop the live hotspot

adjudicated_interference.cause: The pre-fix headless GNOME smoke test sent Stop on the real system bus during this transfer. The service journal records cancellation at 18:05:37 UTC.
adjudicated_interference.replacement_case: NM Wi-Fi-only concurrent transfer after smoke isolation fix
adjudicated_interference.other_historical_fixture_failures: Old-lease/association assumptions, a disabled client Wi-Fi prerequisite, and comparing unrelated Docker interfaces are retained in private diagnostic reports; they were not silently converted into passes.

capture_cleanup.packet_summary_excluded_from_acceptance: Overlapping diagnostic captures; not used as traffic acceptance evidence

limits: One physical Wi-Fi driver and one client OS family.
One-minute corrective load checks are not an eight-hour soak.
No reboot, suspend, full NetworkManager service restart, arbitrary roaming or cross-driver matrix.
Results identify the exact fixed daemon payloads, not the previously published package contents.
